notes: the hair of is added: the Hebrew writes only רֹאשׁ הָאִשָּׁה, fully rendered by the woman's head (rule 30).

הַכֹּהֵן is realized twice, as the fronted subject priest and as the possessive his, in one discontinuous unit (rules 18, 25); the written בְ keeps its own in and the written הָיָה takes the have of the recast possessive clause (rule 43).
